rubric_hint.rule: 1 eligible species recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, none within 250 m
rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: Notified 1.27 ha regeneration felling in Flen, status notified. No completed felling overlaps the polygon (0.0 ha), so it is not already felled.

No eligible species within 250 m. One eligible species lies beyond 250 m but within 1000 m: Sarcosoma globosum (EN, fungus, forest-associated, site-bound). Its listed threats include lack of continuity forest, lack of large or old trees and ground disturbance from forestry. One record, 994 m away (uncertainty 25 m, 2016). This triggers MEDIUM under the rubric.

Within 250 m only one site-bound forest NT species is felling-relevant: Porodaedalea pini at 36 m (2024, uncertainty 50 m). The other NT plants within 250 m are not marked felling-relevant. The 3-species NT trigger is not met.
Effort is adequate: 839 records within 1000 m against a county median of 724 (67th percentile). Near-site there are 14 records inside the polygon and 141 within 250 m, so recording here is dense.

uncertainties: The only eligible record is 994 m away, at the edge of the 1000 m ring, and dates from 2016. It says little about the notified stand, but I did not override the rubric.
Near-site records come from only 1 to 2 observation days, so they may reflect a single visit.
All records are from Artportalen. They show a species was recorded, not that it occupies the site today.
not_established: That Sarcosoma globosum or any threatened species occurs on the notified stand.
Absence of other red-listed species inside the polygon.
That the site is safe to fell, or any legal status of the species.
next_action: Ask a reviewer to check the 2016 Sarcosoma globosum record (GBIF 1430003401) and the 2024 Porodaedalea pini record at 36 m (GBIF 4953249074) against the polygon, and to judge from stand data whether a field check is warranted.
